title: Olivia de Sousa - Videos
description:
Meet Olivia de Sousa, the entrepreneur behind the "Magnetic Pod" podcast and YouTube channel.  Olivia helps female entrepreneurs grow their businesses using podcasting. With over 10 years of experience in podcast management, editing, and content repurposing, Olivia creates captivating episodes that inspire her audience.

Olivia is the secret weapon behind many 6 and 7-figure entrepreneurs, and now she wants to share her insights with you. "Magnetic Pod" offers expert insights and strategies to help entrepreneurs attract their ideal clients and achieve business success.

On this channel, Olivia shares practical tips, motivational insights, and behind-the-scenes glimpses into the world of podcasting and content creation through her YouTube shorts playlist. Join Olivia and the "Magnetic Pod" community to unlock the magnetic potential of your business and create a thriving online presence. Subscribe now to magnetise your business with Olivia de Sousa and "Magnetic Pod".
